THEATRE REVIEW THE CRACKWALKER

Friday, November 16, 1990

ROBERT CUSHMAN

By Judith Thompson Directed by Urjo Kareda and Andy McKim At the Tarragon Theatre in Toronto The Crackwalker tells the bleak story of four people who don't have much going for them, but manages not to be depressing. A harrowing walk with the urban underclass BY ROBERT CUSHMAN Special to The Globe and Mail JUDITH Thompson is being doubly feted - practically festivalized - at Toronto's Tarragon Theatre. Her latest play, Lion in the Streets, is the current main-stage attraction, while the Extra Space has a revival of the piece with which she began her career 10 years ago.
